claim: For seven general points in \(\mathbb P^4\) over a field of characteristic zero, the vector space of degree-\(10\) hypersurfaces vanishing to order at least \(6\) at each point has dimension \(141\) (projective dimension \(140\)); this equals the secant-linear dimension predicted for \(\mathcal L_{4,10}(6^7)\) by the \(n+3\)-point conjecture.

integrity: The modular computation certifies a nonzero minor; the generic conclusion also uses the stated geometric rank bound.
Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: The result concerns only the homogeneous system of degree 10 and multiplicity 6 at seven general points of P^4.
It does not establish the full secant-linear dimension conjecture.

title: Exact dimension of \(\mathcal L_{4,10}(6^7)\)
